# 1. Load data
```{R}
site_data <- st_read("data/beaches_linked.gpkg")
debris_data <- read.csv("outputs/debris_data_with_weights.csv") %>%
               dplyr::select(!X)
gravity_data <- read.csv("outputs/gravity_final.csv") %>%
                filter(!site_name %in% c("Rattray, Grumbell, Grassy Islands", "Goat Island Beach, South Molle Island")) %>%
                dplyr::select(site_name, gravity)
exposure_data <- st_read("outputs/exposure_data.gpkg")
```
# 2. Sensitivity testing on gravity and exposure
## 2.1 Examine gravity outliers
```{R}
# Combine data sets
combined_data <- left_join(debris_data, gravity_data, by = c("Site" = "site_name"))
combined_data <- left_join(combined_data, exposure_data, by = c("Site" = "Sites")) %>%
st_as_sf()
#checking for outliers
outlier <- combined_data %>% group_by(Site) %>% summarise(gravity = first(gravity), exposure = first(site_exposure)) %>% ungroup()
boxplot(outlier$gravity)$out %>% sort()
min(boxplot(outlier$gravity)$out) # < 9.9
boxplot(outlier$exposure)$out %>% sort()
min(boxplot(outlier$exposure)$out)

#examining outliers
data_goutliers <- filter(combined_data, gravity > 9.9) #These are the gravity outliers
#Gravity outliers are not removed as they are not error outliers but rather interesting data points.
```

## 2.2 Explore exposure outlier, and determine best fit for power of fetch length through model selection
```{R}
exposure_testing <- st_read("outputs/exposure_data_testing.gpkg")
combined_data_test <- left_join(debris_data, gravity_data, by = c("Site" = "site_name"))
combined_data_test <- left_join(combined_data_test, exposure_testing, by = c("Site" = "Sites")) %>%
st_as_sf()
exposure_vars <- names(combined_data_test)[7:20] %>% as.character() #Columns of different forms of exposure adjustments
for(i in 1:length(exposure_vars)){
  combined_data_test <- combined_data_test %>% mutate(!!exposure_vars[i] := scale(!!sym(exposure_vars[i]), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
}
combined_data_test <- combined_data_test %>% mutate(gravity = scale(gravity, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
levels_order <- c("Does Not Disperse", "Limited Dispersion", "Encumbered Drift", "Very Mobile", "Unencumbered Drift")
combined_data_test$floatiness <- factor(combined_data_test$floatiness, levels = levels_order)

models <- list()

for(i in 1:length(exposure_vars)){
  formula_str <- paste("Totals ~", exposure_vars[i], "+ floatiness + gravity + gravity*floatiness +", exposure_vars[i], "*floatiness + (1|Site) + (1|year)")
  model <- glmmTMB(as.formula(formula_str), offset(log(num_cleans), data = combined_data_test, family = nbinom2(link = "log"))
  models[[i]] <- model
}
results <- model.sel(models, rank = "AICc")
view(results) # Results showed that the model with a power transformation of 0.3 was the best fit. power of 0.4 or 0.2 were within 2aic but 0.3 makes the most sense (visualising the shape).

#Testing out more refined best fit (to see if fractions of powers make a difference)
exposure_testing <- st_read("outputs/exposure_data_testing2.gpkg")
combined_data_test <- left_join(debris_data, gravity_data, by = c("Site" = "site_name"))
combined_data_test <- left_join(combined_data_test, exposure_testing, by = c("Site" = "Sites")) %>%
st_as_sf()
exposure_vars <- names(combined_data_test)[7:28] %>% as.character() #Columns of different forms of exposure adjustments
for(i in 1:length(exposure_vars)){
  combined_data_test <- combined_data_test %>% mutate(!!exposure_vars[i] := scale(!!sym(exposure_vars[i]), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
}
combined_data_test <- combined_data_test %>% mutate(gravity = scale(gravity, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
levels_order <- c("Does Not Disperse", "Limited Dispersion", "Encumbered Drift", "Very Mobile", "Unencumbered Drift")
combined_data_test$floatiness <- factor(combined_data_test$floatiness, levels = levels_order)

models <- list()

for(i in 1:length(exposure_vars)){
  formula_str <- paste("Totals ~", exposure_vars[i], "+ floatiness + gravity + gravity*floatiness +", exposure_vars[i], "*floatiness + (1|Site) + (1|year)")
  model <- glmmTMB(as.formula(formula_str), offset = log(num_cleans), data = combined_data_test, family = nbinom2(link = "log"))
  models[[i]] <- model
}
results <- model.sel(models, rank = "AICc")
view(results) # Results showed that the model with a power transformation of 0.3 was best fit . Have kept the power level at 0.3 for the final model.
```

## 2.3 Prepare models and do correlation test
```{R}
exposure_lookup <- exposure_testing %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sites, pw_3_exposure) %>%
  distinct()

model_joined_raw <- debris_data %>%
  left_join(
    gravity_data,
    by = c("Site" = "site_name")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    exposure_lookup,
    by = c("Site" = "Sites")
  ) %>%
  rename(site_exposure = pw_3_exposure) %>%
  transmute(
    Site = as.character(Site),
    year = as.character(year),
    num_cleans = as.numeric(num_cleans),
    Totals = as.numeric(Totals),
    floatiness = as.character(floatiness),
    gravity = as.numeric(gravity),
    site_exposure = as.numeric(site_exposure)
  )

debris_counts <- model_joined_raw %>%
  group_by(
    Site,
    year,
    floatiness
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Totals = sum(Totals),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
site_year_covariates <- model_joined_raw %>%
  group_by(
    Site,
    year
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    num_cleans = first(num_cleans),
    gravity = first(gravity),
    site_exposure = first(site_exposure),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
five_floatiness_levels <- c(
  "Does Not Disperse",
  "Limited Dispersion",
  "Encumbered Drift",
  "Very Mobile",
  "Unencumbered Drift"
)

model_data_raw <- site_year_covariates %>%
  tidyr::crossing(
    floatiness = five_floatiness_levels
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    debris_counts,
    by = c(
      "Site",
      "year",
      "floatiness"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Totals = replace_na(Totals, 0),
    floatiness = factor(
      floatiness,
      levels = five_floatiness_levels
    )
  )

five_category_scaling_parameters <- list(
  gravity_center = mean(
    model_data_raw$gravity
  ),
  gravity_scale = sd(
    model_data_raw$gravity
  ),
  site_exposure_center = mean(
    model_data_raw$site_exposure
  ),
  site_exposure_scale = sd(
    model_data_raw$site_exposure
  ),
  gravity_raw_min = min(
    model_data_raw$gravity
  ),
  gravity_raw_max = max(
    model_data_raw$gravity
  ),
  site_exposure_raw_min = min(
    model_data_raw$site_exposure
  ),
  site_exposure_raw_max = max(
    model_data_raw$site_exposure
  )
)
five_category_scaling_parameters$gravity_min <-
  five_category_scaling_parameters$gravity_raw_min

five_category_scaling_parameters$gravity_max <-
  five_category_scaling_parameters$gravity_raw_max

five_category_scaling_parameters$site_exposure_min <-
  five_category_scaling_parameters$site_exposure_raw_min

five_category_scaling_parameters$site_exposure_max <-
  five_category_scaling_parameters$site_exposure_raw_max

# Standardise predictors for the final fitted model.

data_complete <- model_data_raw %>%
  mutate(
    gravity = (
      gravity -
        five_category_scaling_parameters$gravity_center
    ) /
      five_category_scaling_parameters$gravity_scale,

    site_exposure = (
      site_exposure -
        five_category_scaling_parameters$site_exposure_center
    ) /
      five_category_scaling_parameters$site_exposure_scale,

    Site = factor(Site),
    year = factor(year),

    floatiness = factor(
      floatiness,
      levels = five_floatiness_levels
    )
  )

five_category_scaling_parameters$gravity_scaled_min <-
  min(data_complete$gravity)

five_category_scaling_parameters$gravity_scaled_max <-
  max(data_complete$gravity)

five_category_scaling_parameters$site_exposure_scaled_min <-
  min(data_complete$site_exposure)

five_category_scaling_parameters$site_exposure_scaled_max <-
  max(data_complete$site_exposure)

saveRDS(
  five_category_scaling_parameters,
  "outputs/five_category_scaling_parameters.rds"
)

# Create the supplementary two-category dataset.
# num_cleans is retained once and is not summed across categories.

data_reduced <- data_complete %>%
  mutate(
    floatiness = case_when(
      floatiness %in% c(
        "Does Not Disperse",
        "Limited Dispersion"
      ) ~ "Low dispersal capacity",

      TRUE ~ "High dispersal capacity"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Site,
    year,
    num_cleans,
    gravity,
    site_exposure,
    floatiness
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Totals = sum(Totals),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Site = factor(Site),
    year = factor(year),

    floatiness = factor(
      floatiness,
      levels = c(
        "Low dispersal capacity",
        "High dispersal capacity"
      )
    )
  )

# Correlation is calculated once per site using unscaled predictors.

predictor_correlation_data <- model_data_raw %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(
    gravity = first(gravity),
    site_exposure = first(site_exposure),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

predictor_correlation <- cor.test(
  predictor_correlation_data$gravity,
  predictor_correlation_data$site_exposure,
  method = "spearman",
  exact = FALSE
)

print(predictor_correlation) #p-value 0.3944 and rho -0.093 showing gravity and exposure are NOT correlated, so can be used together in the model.
```

# 4. Create predictive models
## 4.1 Fit models
```{r}
#Tried poisson distribution, but overdispersion was present so switched to negative binomial


model_complete <- glmmTMB(
  Totals ~
    gravity * floatiness +
    site_exposure * floatiness +
    (1 | Site) +
    (1 | year) +
    offset(log(num_cleans)),
  data = data_complete,
  family = nbinom2(link = "log")
)

print(summary(model_complete))

type_III_tests <- car::Anova(
  model_complete,
  type = "III"
)

print(type_III_tests)


#disperssal capacity, exposure, and interactions between exposure and gravity with diserpsal capacity all significant. Gravity alone was not significant, but the interaction with dispersal capacity was significant.
model_five_category <- model_complete

saveRDS(
  model_five_category,
  "outputs/five_category_model.rds"
)

#overall model coefficients and confidence intervals
conditional_coefficient_table <- broom.mixed::tidy(
  model_complete,
  effects = "fixed",
  component = "cond",
  conf.int = TRUE,
  conf.level = 0.95
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    rate_ratio = exp(estimate),
    rate_ratio_lower_95 = exp(conf.low),
    rate_ratio_upper_95 = exp(conf.high)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    term,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    rate_ratio,
    rate_ratio_lower_95,
    rate_ratio_upper_95
  )

print(conditional_coefficient_table)

write.csv(
  conditional_coefficient_table,
  "outputs/full_model_conditional_coefficients_with_CI.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
omnibus_tests <- car::Anova(
  model_complete,
  type = "III"
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

print(omnibus_tests)
write.csv(
  omnibus_tests,
  "outputs/full_model_omnibus_tests.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

type_III_table <- as.data.frame(
  type_III_tests
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

write.csv(
  type_III_table,
  "outputs/five_category_type_III_tests.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


model_melted <- glmmTMB(
  Totals ~
    gravity * floatiness +
    site_exposure * floatiness +
    (1 | Site) +
    (1 | year) +
    offset(log(num_cleans)),
  data = data_reduced,
  family = nbinom2(link = "log")
)

print(summary(model_melted))
print(car::Anova(model_melted, type = "III"))

saveRDS(
  model_melted,
  "outputs/melted_model.rds"
)

melted_coefficient_table <- as.data.frame(
  summary(model_melted)$coefficients$cond
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

write.csv(
  melted_coefficient_table,
  "outputs/melted_model_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
# 4.2 five-fold site blocked cross validation
```{r}
#cross validation with cleaned unscaled data
#scaling is recalculated within each fold to avoid data leakage
cv_data <- model_data_raw %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Site = as.character(Site),
    year = as.character(year),
    num_cleans = as.numeric(num_cleans),
    Totals = as.numeric(Totals),
    gravity = as.numeric(gravity),
    site_exposure = as.numeric(site_exposure),

    floatiness = factor(
      floatiness,
      levels = five_floatiness_levels
    )
  )
# Calculate observed site-level accumulation for stratified
# allocation of complete sites to folds.

site_summary <- cv_data %>%
  group_by(Site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    observed_site_year = sum(Totals),
    num_cleans = first(num_cleans),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(
    observed_total = sum(observed_site_year),
    total_cleans = sum(num_cleans),
    observed_per_clean = observed_total / total_cleans,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

n_folds <- 5
cv_seed <- 123

set.seed(cv_seed)

site_summary$fold <- caret::createFolds(
  y = site_summary$observed_per_clean,
  k = n_folds,
  list = FALSE,
  returnTrain = FALSE
)

cv_data <- cv_data %>%
  left_join(
    site_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(Site, fold),
    by = "Site"
  )

fold_assignment_check <- cv_data %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(
    number_of_folds = n_distinct(fold),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(fold_assignment_check$number_of_folds != 1)) {
  stop("At least one site was assigned to more than one fold.")
}

print(
  site_summary %>%
    count(
      fold,
      name = "held_out_sites"
    )
)

fit_cv_model <- function(train_data) {

  glmmTMB(
    Totals ~
      gravity * floatiness +
      site_exposure * floatiness +
      (1 | Site) +
      (1 | year) +
      offset(log(num_cleans)),
    data = train_data,
    family = nbinom2(link = "log")
  )
}

fold_predictions <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = n_folds
)

fold_diagnostics <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = n_folds
)

for (fold_number in seq_len(n_folds)) {

  message(
    "Fitting fold ",
    fold_number,
    " of ",
    n_folds
  )

  train_data <- cv_data %>%
    filter(fold != fold_number) %>%
    dplyr::select(-fold)

  test_data <- cv_data %>%
    filter(fold == fold_number) %>%
    dplyr::select(-fold)

  # Calculate preprocessing parameters from the training fold only.

  gravity_center <- mean(train_data$gravity)
  gravity_scale <- sd(train_data$gravity)

  exposure_center <- mean(
    train_data$site_exposure
  )

  exposure_scale <- sd(
    train_data$site_exposure
  )

  if (
    !is.finite(gravity_scale) ||
      gravity_scale <= 0 ||
      !is.finite(exposure_scale) ||
      exposure_scale <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "A predictor has an invalid standard deviation",
        "in fold",
        fold_number
      )
    )
  }

  train_data <- train_data %>%
    mutate(
      gravity = (
        gravity - gravity_center
      ) / gravity_scale,

      site_exposure = (
        site_exposure - exposure_center
      ) / exposure_scale
    )

  test_data <- test_data %>%
    mutate(
      gravity = (
        gravity - gravity_center
      ) / gravity_scale,

      site_exposure = (
        site_exposure - exposure_center
      ) / exposure_scale
    )

  # Preserve the observed year for later aggregation.

  test_data$observed_year <- test_data$year

  train_data <- train_data %>%
    mutate(
      Site = factor(Site),
      year = factor(year),

      floatiness = factor(
        floatiness,
        levels = five_floatiness_levels
      )
    )

  # Fixed-effect predictions do not use the estimated year effect.
  # A valid training-year factor level is nevertheless provided to
  # avoid a new-level error during prediction.

  reference_year <- levels(train_data$year)[1]

  test_data <- test_data %>%
    mutate(
      Site = factor(Site),

      year = factor(
        reference_year,
        levels = levels(train_data$year)
      ),

      floatiness = factor(
        floatiness,
        levels = five_floatiness_levels
      )
    )

  fold_model <- fit_cv_model(
    train_data
  )

  convergence_code <-
    fold_model$fit$convergence

  positive_definite_hessian <-
    isTRUE(fold_model$sdr$pdHess)

  if (convergence_code != 0) {
    warning(
      paste(
        "Fold",
        fold_number,
        "returned convergence code",
        convergence_code
      )
    )
  }

  if (!positive_definite_hessian) {
    warning(
      paste(
        "Fold",
        fold_number,
        "did not return a positive-definite Hessian."
      )
    )
  }

  # re.form = NA excludes both site and year random effects.
  # Predictions therefore represent previously unobserved sites.

  test_data$predicted_total <- predict(
    fold_model,
    newdata = test_data,
    type = "response",
    re.form = NA,
    allow.new.levels = TRUE
  )

  fold_predictions[[fold_number]] <- test_data %>%
    transmute(
      fold = fold_number,
      Site = as.character(Site),
      year = observed_year,
      num_cleans,
      floatiness,
      observed_total = Totals,
      predicted_total
    )

  fold_diagnostics[[fold_number]] <- data.frame(
    fold = fold_number,
    training_sites = n_distinct(train_data$Site),
    held_out_sites = n_distinct(test_data$Site),
    gravity_center,
    gravity_scale,
    exposure_center,
    exposure_scale,
    convergence_code,
    positive_definite_hessian
  )
}

out_of_fold_rows <- bind_rows(
  fold_predictions
)

fold_diagnostics <- bind_rows(
  fold_diagnostics
)

print(fold_diagnostics)

if (
  n_distinct(out_of_fold_rows$Site) !=
    n_distinct(cv_data$Site)
) {
  stop("Not every site received an out-of-fold prediction.")
}

# Sum predictions across all five categories within each site-year.
# num_cleans is retained only once per site-year.

site_year_predictions <- out_of_fold_rows %>%
  group_by(
    fold,
    Site,
    year
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    num_cleans = first(num_cleans),
    n_effort_values = n_distinct(num_cleans),
    n_categories = n_distinct(floatiness),
    observed_total = sum(observed_total),
    predicted_total = sum(predicted_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(site_year_predictions$n_effort_values != 1)) {
  stop("Effort is inconsistent in the held-out predictions.")
}

if (any(site_year_predictions$n_categories != 5)) {
  stop("Some held-out site-years do not contain all five categories.")
}

# Produce one independent observed and predicted value per site.

site_predictions <- site_year_predictions %>%
  group_by(
    fold,
    Site
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    years_observed = n_distinct(year),
    total_cleans = sum(num_cleans),
    observed_total = sum(observed_total),
    predicted_total = sum(predicted_total),

    observed_per_clean =
      observed_total / total_cleans,

    predicted_per_clean =
      predicted_total / total_cleans,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (anyDuplicated(site_predictions$Site)) {
  stop("At least one site occurs more than once in site_predictions.")
}

# Overall pooled rank agreement.

spearman_rho <- cor(
  site_predictions$observed_per_clean,
  site_predictions$predicted_per_clean,
  method = "spearman"
)

# Independently classify observed and predicted values using
# their 33.3% and 66.7% quantiles.

observed_terciles <- quantile(
  site_predictions$observed_per_clean,
  probs = c(1 / 3, 2 / 3),
  type = 7,
  names = FALSE
)

predicted_terciles <- quantile(
  site_predictions$predicted_per_clean,
  probs = c(1 / 3, 2 / 3),
  type = 7,
  names = FALSE
)

tercile_thresholds <- data.frame(
  value_type = c(
    "Observed",
    "Predicted"
  ),

  low_medium_threshold = c(
    observed_terciles[1],
    predicted_terciles[1]
  ),

  medium_high_threshold = c(
    observed_terciles[2],
    predicted_terciles[2]
  )
)

classify_tercile <- function(x, breaks) {

  case_when(
    x <= breaks[1] ~ "Low",
    x <= breaks[2] ~ "Medium",
    TRUE ~ "High"
  )
}

site_predictions <- site_predictions %>%
  mutate(
    observed_class = factor(
      classify_tercile(
        observed_per_clean,
        observed_terciles
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Low",
        "Medium",
        "High"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),

    predicted_class = factor(
      classify_tercile(
        predicted_per_clean,
        predicted_terciles
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Low",
        "Medium",
        "High"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),

    observed_class_number =
      as.integer(observed_class),

    predicted_class_number =
      as.integer(predicted_class)
  )

# Rows are observed classes; columns are predicted classes.

tercile_confusion_matrix <- table(
  Observed = site_predictions$observed_class,
  Predicted = site_predictions$predicted_class
)

print(tercile_confusion_matrix)

tercile_confusion_table <-
  as.data.frame.matrix(
    tercile_confusion_matrix
  ) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Observed")

observed_high <-
  site_predictions$observed_class == "High"

predicted_high <-
  site_predictions$predicted_class == "High"

true_positive_high <- sum(
  observed_high & predicted_high
)

high_precision <- if (sum(predicted_high) > 0) {
  true_positive_high / sum(predicted_high)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

high_recall <- if (sum(observed_high) > 0) {
  true_positive_high / sum(observed_high)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

high_medium_or_high_recall <- if (
  sum(observed_high) > 0
) {
  mean(
    site_predictions$predicted_class[
      observed_high
    ] %in% c("Medium", "High")
  )
} else {
  NA_real_
}

exact_tercile_accuracy <- mean(
  site_predictions$observed_class_number ==
    site_predictions$predicted_class_number
)

within_one_tercile_accuracy <- mean(
  abs(
    site_predictions$observed_class_number -
      site_predictions$predicted_class_number
  ) <= 1
)

opposite_tercile_error <- mean(
  abs(
    site_predictions$observed_class_number -
      site_predictions$predicted_class_number
  ) == 2
)

classification_metrics <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "Number of held-out sites",
    "Spearman rank correlation",
    "Observed high-accumulation sites",
    "Predicted high-accumulation sites",
    "Correctly identified high-accumulation sites",
    "High-tercile precision",
    "High-tercile recall",
    "Observed-high predicted Medium or High",
    "Exact tercile accuracy",
    "Accuracy within one tercile",
    "Opposite-tercile error rate"
  ),

  value = c(
    nrow(site_predictions),
    spearman_rho,
    sum(observed_high),
    sum(predicted_high),
    true_positive_high,
    high_precision,
    high_recall,
    high_medium_or_high_recall,
    exact_tercile_accuracy,
    within_one_tercile_accuracy,
    opposite_tercile_error
  )
)

print(classification_metrics)

# Fold-specific performance.
#
# The pooled tercile thresholds above are retained across folds.
# Thresholds are not recalculated independently within each fold.

fold_metrics <- site_predictions %>%
  group_by(fold) %>%
  summarise(
    held_out_sites = n(),

    spearman_rho = suppressWarnings(
      cor(
        observed_per_clean,
        predicted_per_clean,
        method = "spearman"
      )
    ),

    exact_tercile_accuracy = mean(
      observed_class_number ==
        predicted_class_number
    ),

    within_one_tercile_accuracy = mean(
      abs(
        observed_class_number -
          predicted_class_number
      ) <= 1
    ),

    observed_high_sites = sum(
      observed_class == "High"
    ),

    observed_high_predicted_high = if (
      sum(observed_class == "High") > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        predicted_class[
          observed_class == "High"
        ] == "High"
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    observed_high_predicted_medium_or_high = if (
      sum(observed_class == "High") > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        predicted_class[
          observed_class == "High"
        ] %in% c("Medium", "High")
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )

fold_variability <- fold_metrics %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spearman_rho =
      mean(spearman_rho, na.rm = TRUE),

    sd_spearman_rho =
      sd(spearman_rho, na.rm = TRUE),

    minimum_spearman_rho =
      min(spearman_rho, na.rm = TRUE),

    maximum_spearman_rho =
      max(spearman_rho, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_exact_tercile_accuracy =
      mean(
        exact_tercile_accuracy,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    sd_exact_tercile_accuracy =
      sd(
        exact_tercile_accuracy,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_within_one_tercile_accuracy =
      mean(
        within_one_tercile_accuracy,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    sd_within_one_tercile_accuracy =
      sd(
        within_one_tercile_accuracy,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_observed_high_predicted_high =
      mean(
        observed_high_predicted_high,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    sd_observed_high_predicted_high =
      sd(
        observed_high_predicted_high,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_observed_high_predicted_medium_or_high =
      mean(
        observed_high_predicted_medium_or_high,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    sd_observed_high_predicted_medium_or_high =
      sd(
        observed_high_predicted_medium_or_high,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )

print(fold_metrics)
print(fold_variability)

# Bootstrap uncertainty by resampling held-out sites.

validation_bootstrap <- function(data, indices) {

  sampled_data <- data[indices, ]

  sampled_observed_high <-
    sampled_data$observed_class == "High"

  sampled_predicted_high <-
    sampled_data$predicted_class == "High"

  sampled_true_positive <- sum(
    sampled_observed_high &
      sampled_predicted_high
  )

  sampled_precision <- if (
    sum(sampled_predicted_high) > 0
  ) {
    sampled_true_positive /
      sum(sampled_predicted_high)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  sampled_recall <- if (
    sum(sampled_observed_high) > 0
  ) {
    sampled_true_positive /
      sum(sampled_observed_high)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  sampled_medium_or_high_recall <- if (
    sum(sampled_observed_high) > 0
  ) {
    mean(
      sampled_data$predicted_class[
        sampled_observed_high
      ] %in% c("Medium", "High")
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  c(
    spearman_rho = suppressWarnings(
      cor(
        sampled_data$observed_per_clean,
        sampled_data$predicted_per_clean,
        method = "spearman"
      )
    ),

    high_precision = sampled_precision,

    high_recall = sampled_recall,

    high_medium_or_high_recall =
      sampled_medium_or_high_recall,

    exact_tercile_accuracy = mean(
      sampled_data$observed_class_number ==
        sampled_data$predicted_class_number
    ),

    within_one_tercile_accuracy = mean(
      abs(
        sampled_data$observed_class_number -
          sampled_data$predicted_class_number
      ) <= 1
    )
  )
}

set.seed(cv_seed)

bootstrap_results <- boot::boot(
  data = site_predictions,
  statistic = validation_bootstrap,
  R = 2000
)

bootstrap_metric_names <- c(
  "Spearman rank correlation",
  "High-tercile precision",
  "High-tercile recall",
  "Observed-high predicted Medium or High",
  "Exact tercile accuracy",
  "Accuracy within one tercile"
)

confidence_intervals <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_along(bootstrap_metric_names),
  function(metric_number) {

    interval <- boot::boot.ci(
      bootstrap_results,
      type = "perc",
      index = metric_number
    )

    if (is.null(interval$percent)) {

      lower_limit <- NA_real_
      upper_limit <- NA_real_

    } else {

      lower_limit <- interval$percent[4]
      upper_limit <- interval$percent[5]
    }

    tibble(
      metric =
        bootstrap_metric_names[metric_number],

      estimate =
        bootstrap_results$t0[metric_number],

      lower_95 = lower_limit,
      upper_95 = upper_limit
    )
  }
)

print(confidence_intervals)

# Explicitly evaluate the former top- and bottom-ten claim.

observed_top_10 <- site_predictions %>%
  arrange(
    desc(observed_per_clean),
    Site
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Site)

predicted_top_10 <- site_predictions %>%
  arrange(
    desc(predicted_per_clean),
    Site
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Site)

observed_bottom_10 <- site_predictions %>%
  arrange(
    observed_per_clean,
    Site
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Site)

predicted_bottom_10 <- site_predictions %>%
  arrange(
    predicted_per_clean,
    Site
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Site)

extreme_rank_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "Observed top 10 also in predicted top 10",
    "Observed bottom 10 also in predicted bottom 10",
    "Observed top 10 assigned to predicted High",
    "Observed bottom 10 assigned to predicted Low"
  ),

  value = c(
    length(
      intersect(
        observed_top_10,
        predicted_top_10
      )
    ),

    length(
      intersect(
        observed_bottom_10,
        predicted_bottom_10
      )
    ),

    sum(
      site_predictions$Site %in%
        observed_top_10 &
        site_predictions$predicted_class ==
          "High"
    ),

    sum(
      site_predictions$Site %in%
        observed_bottom_10 &
        site_predictions$predicted_class ==
          "Low"
    )
  )
)

extreme_rank_sites <- site_predictions %>%
  mutate(
    observed_extreme_group = case_when(
      Site %in% observed_top_10 ~
        "Observed top 10",

      Site %in% observed_bottom_10 ~
        "Observed bottom 10",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    observed_rank =
      min_rank(desc(observed_per_clean)),

    predicted_rank =
      min_rank(desc(predicted_per_clean))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(observed_extreme_group)
  ) %>%
  arrange(observed_rank)

print(extreme_rank_summary)
```

```{R}
data_high_disp <- data_complete %>%
                  filter(floatiness %in% c("Encumbered Drift", "Unencumbered Drift", "Very Mobile")) %>%
                  group_by(Site, year, floatiness) %>%
                  summarize(exposure = first(site_exposure), gravity = first(gravity), Totals = sum(Totals), num_cleans = first(num_cleans)) %>%
                  ungroup()
data_low_disp <- data_complete %>%
                 filter(floatiness %in% c("Does Not Disperse", "Limited Dispersion")) %>%
                  group_by(Site, year, floatiness) %>%
                  summarize(gravity = first(gravity), exposure = first(site_exposure), Totals = sum(Totals), num_cleans = first(num_cleans)) %>%
                  ungroup()
Cmodel_lowdis_cmp <- glmmTMB(
  Totals ~
    gravity * floatiness +
    exposure * floatiness +
    (1 | Site) +
    (1 | year) +
    offset(log(num_cleans)),
  data = data_low_disp,
  family = nbinom2(link = "log")
)

Cmodel_highdis_cmp <- glmmTMB(
  Totals ~
    exposure * floatiness +
    gravity * floatiness +
    (1 | Site) +
    (1 | year) +
    offset(log(num_cleans)),
  data = data_high_disp,
  family = nbinom2(link = "log")
)
```
